info.title: money:care Platform API
info.description:
This is the public API of the money:care Platform.

Reference data is based on [ESMA FIRDS](https://registers.esma.europa.eu/publication/searchRegister?core=esma_registers_firds), [GLEIF LEI data](https://www.gleif.org/en/meta/lei-data-terms-of-use) and [OpenFIGI](https://www.openfigi.com/docs/terms-of-service); MIC resolution uses [ISO 10383](https://www.iso.org/standard/61067.html). The data is processed and enriched by money:care. No source provider endorses money:care or its products.

tags.name: Portfolio API
tags.description: The Portfolio API calculates sustainability scores of a portfolio consisting of companies and equity funds. It automatically retrieves holdings data from the money:care database or uses user-provided holdings. The API then calculates sustainability metrics—including overall impact, climate, society, and gender indicators—to help you understand the sustainability performance of your portfolio.

post.summary: Calculate sustainability scores for a group of companies and equity funds.
post.description: This endpoint accepts a list of companies with their ISINs and assigned weights. It then returns aggregated sustainability impact metrics for the entire group, including the total and available weight of the portfolio, impact scores (overall, climate, society, and gender), underlying indicators, and coverage details. It also identifies any ISINs for which data is not available.

playlistId.description: Playlist id. Required for detail and position-level actions, including JUMP_TO_LEAD_FORM, COMPLETION_OF_LEAD_SIGNUP and ORDER_COMPLETED; optional for PLAYLIST_OVERVIEW_VIEWED.

isin.description: Security ISIN. Required for WATCHLIST_ADD, JUMP_TO_ORDER_FLOW, JUMP_TO_LEAD_FORM, COMPLETION_OF_LEAD_SIGNUP, ORDER_COMPLETED, JUMP_TO_STOCK_DASHBOARD, SHOW_MORE and CALL_TO_ACTION.

sortOrder.description: Position sort order. Optional, but recommended for position-level actions.

isins.description: ISINs to look up. Values are matched case-insensitively after trimming and whitespace normalization. Maximum: 5000.

items.description: ISINs to look up. Values are matched case-insensitively after trimming and whitespace normalization. Maximum: 5000.

includePositions.description: Flag to configure whether positions should be included. Defaults to false.

positionsLimit.description: Amount of Playlist Positions that should be returned for a Playlist. Only applies when includePositions is true.

PlaylistLookupRequestPDTO.description: Bulk playlist lookup request. Accepts up to 5000 ISINs.

playlists.description: Unique playlists matching at least one requested ISIN, ordered by playlist sortOrder and id.

additionalProperties.description: First submitted trimmed ISIN to matching playlist ids. Each list follows the same order as playlists.

items.description: First submitted trimmed ISIN to matching playlist ids. Each list follows the same order as playlists.

matchesByIsin.description: First submitted trimmed ISIN to matching playlist ids. Each list follows the same order as playlists.
